what: Measured records of the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next profile. Every row NF never measured is BORROWED from qwen27b by name (UNIFY_PLAN Risiko (c)); an NF record of the same name replaces it.

records.name: D_FIXED_MIB
records.provenance: #145 fixed post per D rank = 'weights + runtime state' of the runtime's own KV budget posts line - buffer x 48 x 2.417 MiB (weg2/d_awake_rest.py), max over the NF Dauerlauf boots rc12 (530fb713ce, two boots), rc12b (c6868a1e13), rc12c (2e3e38b87c): TP0 20436 - 112 x 116.0 = 7442 in all four; replaces the fnFL2x151/x158 reference 7264/1044/922 the solve priced the form with (rc12c: 'Rest nach KV 1202 -> PASST' beside a card that died).

records.name: D_AWAKE_REST_MIB
records.provenance: rc12c: what the awake D rank holds BEYOND its booked form, measured against the form and never against the budget (weg2/d_awake_rest.py): demand at the edge (torch OOM line: capacity - free - other processes + refused request) - the form's posts (W+R + mamba + spec + activation + 262144 x cell, same log). TP0: rc12 3129 and 3077, rc12b 3039, rc12c 3186 -- under budgets 29624/29624/29144/28288 the rest stays 3039-3186 (the budget-relative D_OVERSHOOT_MIB it replaces went 428/353/826/1798: no fixpoint). Covers CUDA graphs 498, untagged 2036-2340, unreusable allocator/private-pool cache, unattributed 331-362 at the edge. LOWER bound (the rank died there). 3080 ranks: no edge on NF, not measured (null: the builtin 404 stays there).
records.power_limit_source: not recorded per record; the rig ran 5090 400 W / 3080 230 W (row 27)

records.name: D_ACTIVATION_MIB
records.provenance: rc12e: the D activation post of the #145 solve = the MEASURED maximum of the extend transient on D-TP0 (WEG2-VRAM-PEAK transient_mib = peak_allocated - start_allocated, phase=chunk and the phase=round that holds the draft extend), rounded up to 8 MiB: rc12d (227ae1becd) chunk rows=4059 1101 (max), round 994; rc12c (2e3e38b87c) round 1006; rc12b (c6868a1e13) round 934 -- every window >= 800 MiB carried an allocator retry against the booked 1024 of the fnFL2 reference. The persistent gather ring (16 rows x 2.417 MiB = 38.7 MiB per rank since 227ae1becd) is NOT in this post: it is a fixed post, added to D_FIXED_MIB by the solve. 3080 ranks: no transient edge measured on NF (null: the reference 1024 stays there).
records.power_limit_source: not a power-dependent quantity (bytes one extend adds)

records.name: D_EXTEND_GROWTH_MIB
records.provenance: rc12f: what ONE D extend window adds to torch reserved on D-TP0 = peak_reserved of the window that holds the extend's peak minus reserved at the window's start (WEG2-VRAM-PEAK), max over the extends with >= 512 rows (weg2/extend_trim.extend_growth_mib): rc12e (f078f89a08) 03:39:12 rows=4096 transient 920 -> +2304 (card_free 2371 -> 67), 03:41:23 +2272, 03:33:37 +2026 (retry); rc12d (227ae1becd) 02:37:45 +1974, 02:41:14 +1852 (retry); rc12c/rc12b below. The allocator lays new segments on top of a cache it cannot reuse: growth/transient 2.0-2.5 on the 4096-row extends, so the booked activation (1104) under-prices the extend's card cost. Measured against the window start, never against the trim threshold: a trim empties the cache and the growth that follows is the extend's real segment demand, bounded -- no ratchet. The trim threshold is floor + max(activation, this). 3080 ranks: not measured (null: floor + activation stays).
records.power_limit_source: not a power-dependent quantity (bytes one extend adds)

records.name: D_EXTEND_GROWTH_PER_ROW_MIB
records.provenance: rc12g (8f0bf40c2f, boot dkrnfh91bar1dauer09270501): 05:31:15 and 05:35:05 each 2688 rows uncut, reserved growth 1578 MiB -> 0.5871/row (1578/2688 rounded up to 4 decimals, > 0.5625; at post 2327 the 0.5625 cap 3584 would have left 223 MiB); measured maximum raised -- no ratchet, the rate does not depend on the cut (fixpoint). The identical 1578 at identical rows points to a fixed part (growth = a + b*rows); the per-row maximum then overprices larger chunks (conservative). rc12g: reserved growth of ONE D extend per row on D-TP0 = (peak_reserved of the windows from the '#969 EXTENT' line up to the extend's chunk window - reserved at the extend's start, after its trim) / extend rows, max over the extends with >= 2048 rows (weg2/extend_trim.extend_growth_per_row_mib; where the window opened before the trim its peak is the PRE-trim level, then the card_free drop after the trim is the growth). rc12e (f078f89a08) 03:39:07 4096 rows +2304 -> 0.5625 (max), 03:39:12 4072 +2272 -> 0.558, 03:40:51 0.555; rc12f (26af2ccdca) 04:27:50 4029 +2116 -> 0.525 (card_free 207 after), 04:22:03 3073 +1656 -> 0.539, 04:27:45 / 04:21:25 4096 +1992 -> 0.486; rc12d (227ae1becd) <= 0.482; rc12c/rc12b <= 0.225. Rows < 2048 are not a per-row quantity: rc12b 00:18:02, 603 rows, +776 MiB (1.29/row) is the decode/draft rounds inside the same window. A cut chunk has fewer rows and proportionally less growth, so the rate does not move with the cut (no ratchet). The D scheduler caps the extend chunk to floor((card_free_post - 300) / rate). 3080 ranks: not measured (null: no vote).
records.power_limit_source: not a power-dependent quantity (bytes per extend row)

records.name: P_ACTIVATION_MIB
records.provenance: #242: group P's prefill transient per P stage at chunk 16384, planner definition peak_allocated - allocated after the chunk (p_card_chunk ChunkWindow.transient_planner_mib), maximum over EVERY WEG2-VRAM-PEAK phase=chunk window of 62 NF boots 26.-28.09. (cut 29,11,8, FR_P 0.324/0.637/0.734, chunk 16384), rounded up to 8 MiB. LOAD STATE = sequences in ONE chunk (the rank's last '#969N ADMIT bs=' before the window): PP0 bs1 3441 (n=306, rows 16384), bs2 4394, bs3 5310 (dkrnfh91dprsabar1dauer09271947 20:30:27, rows 16320), bs4 5979 (dkrnfh91visbar1dauer09271103 11:09:50, rows 16300), bs5 3947 (11182 rows); PP1 2945 and PP2 2941 in every bs (n~2800). COVERAGE: bs 1..5 per chunk seen, bs6 in one chunk (6 seats) NOT seen -- not extrapolated. ELASTIC: freed after the forward (the allocator keeps it reserved). Replaces the builtin 16384 support point 3697/3287/3267 (fnFL2x118..x146, one sequence per chunk): the runtime post and the pool model book it per stage; the P-KARTE takes max(builtin, record).
records.power_limit_source: POWER-LIMIT line of every named boot: nvml0=230 nvml1=400 nvml2=230 W

records.name: P_PP_STAGE_FIXED_MIB
records.provenance: #242: per-stage non-layer weight + runtime state of THIS checkpoint, recovered as the runtime's own 'KV budget posts' weights + runtime state (16.836/10.475/9.221 GiB = 17240.1/10726.4/9442.3 MiB, identical on every 28.09. NF boot of this FR) minus the pool model's per-layer term at the same FR and cut (PP-CUT POOL TERM 539.87/927.21/1047.11 MiB/layer x 29/11/8, recovered from PP-POOL-JOIN priced_per_rank 796942/778073/653934 x cell 7168/3072/2048 B). With it the PP-POOL-JOIN of the 11:11 boot joins priced and realised available bytes to <= 2 MiB/rank (before: -758/-988/-2883 MiB -- the 27B row 2342/1106/3518 carried a draft head on the last stage that NF's P no longer holds, H25). One FR measured: a boot at another FR_P re-checks it (Metall-Marker PP-POOL-JOIN).
records.power_limit_source: POWER-LIMIT line of every named boot: nvml0=230 nvml1=400 nvml2=230 W

records.name: P_MAMBA_MIB_PER_LINEAR_LAYER_PER_SLOT
records.provenance: #242: the runtime's 'mamba state pool + speculative intermediate state + prefill activation reserve' post (1.072/0.390/0.292 GiB; spec 0 and activation 0 on P since the transient has its own post) over linear layers x slots (22/8/6 x 32): 1.5594/1.5602/1.5573 MiB per linear layer per slot, maximum 1.5602 -- the 27B row measured 1.5588, same GDN state geometry.
records.power_limit_source: not a power-dependent quantity (bytes of the GDN state)

records.name: P_OVERSHOOT_MIB
records.provenance: #240: group P's awake footprint beyond its budget per P ordinal, measured at the CARD (CUDA context and every non-torch byte included, the part a torch-only peak_reserved never sees): excess = corridor + booked overshoot - free card at the window peak (card_free_mib - (peak_reserved - reserved) of every WEG2-VRAM-PEAK window), and the record is the part the corridor's builtin awake_overshoot 404 does not carry: max(0, excess - 404), so the free card at the observed peak lands on the measured floor instead of below it. Assumes the P footprint follows its budget 1:1 (FR_P residency fills it) -- the conservative side. Worst window per ordinal: PP0 +856 excess (free 1523 MiB, 7d507357b9 14:47, chunk) -> 452; PP1 +801 (free 698, dwell30 14:59, chunk) -> 397; PP2 +74 at most (free >= 1700 in every boot) -> 0. Replaces the 27B row [920, 0, 512] (boot weg2ls2b2) the NF line borrowed since 76f8debf2c: PP0 budget +468, PP1 -397, PP2 +512 against it. Coverage: 10 boots x 69-596 windows per rank, chunk/idle/flip/round phases, cut 29,11,8, bs 1..5 in a chunk; bs6 in one chunk not seen. The P activation is booked inside the budget (P_ACTIVATION_MIB, #242), so a heavier chunk raises the torch peak inside the budget, not this excess.
records.power_limit_source: not a power-dependent quantity (bytes outside the budget)

borrow.why: the 27B measurement the NF line has read since its base 76f8debf2c; kept so the NF argv stays byte-identical (P_/D_OVERSHOOT_MIB shape it), printed as BORROWED by the launcher. Replacing a row needs an NF control boot (P_/D_OVERSHOOT first).
